sources.title: Some Complexity Questions Related to Distributive Computing (Preliminary Report)
sources.enterprise_use: Provides foundational communication-complexity prior art for treating information exchange required to compute a function as a complexity object. P018 uses only a finite deterministic one-message specialization after coarse input classes are fixed.
sources.not_claimed: Communication complexity, lower bounds on communication for function computation, and distributed function-computation models are established and are not Enterprise Math inventions.

sources.title: Coding for Computing
sources.enterprise_use: Provides established coding-for-computing prior art in which communication/coding is tailored to a target function and decoder side information. P018's transport token is a much simpler finite deterministic zero-error specialization and is not claimed as a new coding model.
sources.not_claimed: Functional compression, coding for computing, and exploiting decoder side information to reduce communication are established information theory and are not Enterprise Math inventions.
